raw: {"note": "Changing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 is a standard regularization tweak that leaves the fixed evaluation untouched (train shards 0-9 don't overlap eval shard 10), so val_bpb still measures real model quality, even though the DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=64/LR=0.02 base described in the post doesn't match the current train.py config.", "verdict": "ok"}

parsed.note: Changing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.1 is a standard regularization tweak that leaves the fixed evaluation untouched (train shards 0-9 don't overlap eval shard 10), so val_bpb still measures real model quality, even though the DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=64/LR=0.02 base described in the post doesn't match the current train.py config.
